title: Converge Omnirepo on its Constitution
description:
## Goal

Bring the current 0.8.x implementation into complete alignment with the ratified Omnirepo Constitution and routed Canon architecture.

## Current state

The quality baseline passes, but the implemented product is still a general multi-repository CLI: it creates and clones repositories, runs arbitrary shell commands, accepts ad hoc sync sources, and performs whole-file writes from a central directory list. It does not yet implement constitutional machine/source authority, per-repository applicability and commands, partial managed sections, verified commit/push lifecycle, durable run records, bounded repair, or migration.

## Program rule

Child beads must preserve exact-text synchronization, one-way ordered source authority, independent repository outcomes, complete accounting, and the Boundary 5 repair limit. Every child must add or update tests and pass the repository Canon quality gates.

## Success Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field; every child must close before the epic is eligible.
acceptance_criteria: All child beads are closed; the final implementation passes the Constitution gate across the full product surface; Cargo quality, MSRV, coverage, and pre-commit gates pass; public docs describe only the constitutional product.
notes: Decision-needed and human-input children are policy blockers for the project owner. Agents may audit or prepare questions but must not implement or close them by guessing. Implementation work should be selected only after its decision dependencies are resolved.

title: Remove the arbitrary multi-repository run surface
description:
Boundary 1 forbids a general repository orchestrator. The public run command and src/run/runners.rs accept arbitrary shell strings and execute sh -c across repositories. Remove only this public and general runner surface, its tests, docs, verbose/global logging coupled to it, and any equivalent arbitrary fleet command. The repository-declared verifier is owned separately and must not be implemented here.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: omnirepo help no longer advertises run; clap rejects it; no production API accepts an arbitrary user-supplied fleet command; general runner, obsolete tests, docs, and misleading logger help are removed; no replacement general command is introduced; Canon quality gates pass.

title: Orchestrate independent per-repository lifecycle and complete outcomes
description:
Compose resolved plan application, repository verification, scoped Git delivery, and outcome collection. Each destination proceeds independently under configured parallelism; completion order is unspecified; one final typed outcome is retained for every fleet member. This bead owns sequencing and aggregation, while dedicated adapters own command and Git mechanics.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Each declared repository yields exactly one final outcome covering plan, sync, check, commit, and push stages; valid peers finish despite any other failure or hang bounded by policy; changed repositories reach Git only after all original checks pass; unchanged repositories avoid Git mutation; sync, spawn, nonzero, signal, timeout, commit, and push failures are distinct; a push failure retains and reports any local commit identity; completion order never changes accounting; concurrency limits and sequential per-repo stages are tested.

title: Write complete durable run summaries with quiet success output
description:
Serialize the decided stable run model for every fleet invocation and render concise terminal output. Securely establish a unique durable record before repository mutation, journal or finalize it according to the decided crash contract, retain exactly one entry per selected repository plus run-level preflight evidence, and apply the decided sensitive-data and evidence policy.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Empty, preflight-failed, partial, cancelled, and successful invocations produce exactly one collision-safe record at the canonical path under the decided schema; every selected repository has one final entry; creation, concurrent timestamps, crash recovery, atomic finalization, permissions, redaction, output bounds, and persistence failure match policy; routine success output is measurably concise; failure output names failed repositories and the record path.

title: Implement separately invoked bounded agent-assisted repair
description:
Invoke a separate bounded repair operation only for failures proven eligible under the current run and repository lineage. Freeze the original synchronization plan and verification policy. Use the confined agent adapter, reject uncertain or unrelated causation and forbidden deltas, consume attempts exactly as decided, then reapply synchronization and rerun the original checks before any Git delivery.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Eligibility distinguishes introduced from pre-existing failure using durable run evidence; uncertain or unrelated failures make no repair changes; original repository policy and checks cannot be weakened or removed; attempts, refusals, crashes, timeouts, fallback, restart, and exhaustion follow the decided budget; machine config, sources, other repositories, run evidence, Git authority, and unrelated filesystem state are protected outside prompts; every accepted attempt is recorded, re-synced, reverified, and only a clean pass may use the Git adapter; peers remain independent.

title: Implement explicitly delegated breaking migration operation
description:
Implement the owner-decided declared migration artifact and separately invoked migration operation requested for breaking Omnirepo releases. Migration begins only after explicit delegation, applies only the selected version-applicable Omnirepo migration to destinations, uses confined agents when declared, and follows the decided verification, Git, record, idempotence, and partial-failure lifecycle.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: A breaking release includes actionable human guidance and the decided machine-readable declaration; migration never starts implicitly; explicit invocation validates version applicability and applies only the named idempotent migration; machine fleet membership, authoritative source content, source priority, and unrelated maintenance remain protected; every destination is verified and delivered through the decided lifecycle or reported failed; successful, repeated, refused, failed, and out-of-scope cases are tested.

title: Align CLI, package metadata, and docs with constitutional synchronization
description:
After the machine-driven CLI and migration behavior land, align help, README, package metadata and contents, examples, and migration guidance with authoritative file and section synchronization. Document only decided formats, controls, errors, limits, repair and Git behavior; inventory the actual 0.8.x breaks and provide actionable migration steps.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Public wording and package contents describe only constitutional synchronization; legacy new, run, tag-clone, ad hoc source, .omni.yaml, and generic manager claims are gone from current docs and help; setup reaches a first inferred sync; examples match exact schemas and delimiters; 0.8.x breaks have actionable guidance and declared migration where provided; packaged artifacts intentionally include or exclude Canon, agent files, and Beads; help, error, docs, and package audits pass.

title: Remove the legacy tag-based clone workflow
description:
Remove the public legacy clone --tags workflow and central .omni.yaml generation. This bead is pure removal of tag-driven destination fleet orchestration, its tests, and docs. It does not retain, redesign, or promise source materialization; the separate source policy and catalog beads own any future internal acquisition.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Public help and APIs expose no tag-driven clone; tag matching cannot determine fleet membership or applicability; .omni.yaml is not generated; legacy implementation, tests, and docs are removed without introducing replacement cloning behavior; Canon quality gates pass.

title: Define source-repository materialization policy
description:
Owner decision required for materializing machine-declared authoritative source repositories. Select supported source references, checkout or cache placement, refresh and revision selection per run, dirty-source handling, authentication source, ambient Git configuration and URL rewriting, secret redaction, scheme and redirect policy, timeout, retry and backoff, offline behavior, submodules, LFS and filters, and failure cleanup. Configuration syntax and declaration identity are owned by separate decisions.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner selects supported source references and the complete acquisition, revision, auth, network, timeout, retry, cache, dirty-state, extension, cleanup, and redaction lifecycle; the owning Canon page records durable guarantees; source loading can proceed without inheriting accidental reqwest, Git, credential-helper, proxy, or tag-clone behavior.

title: Define ownership and precedence for fleet execution controls
description:
Owner decision required for fleet parallelism, agent discovery priority, repair limits, and harness options. Assign each control to a configuration tier and define precedence and any CLI override, default, valid range, zero value, and per-run versus per-repository scope. Repository policy must never gain fleet, source, or priority authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner assigns all four control families, exact precedence, defaults, ranges, zero behavior, override rules, and scope; the owning Canon page records the durable rule; configuration, lifecycle, agent, and repair beads adopt the selected schema without relying on Rayon or legacy CLI defaults.

title: Define configuration serialization, discovery, and conflict policy
description:
Owner decision required before the canonical machine, repository, and source-declaration schemas can be implemented. Select supported formats and exact filenames, destination reference form and existence policy, canonical discovery only, behavior when multiple candidate files or legacy .omni.yaml exist, unknown-field handling, and path or identity normalization. Current YAML locations and CLI config overrides are legacy mechanisms, not authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner explicitly selects formats, filenames, discovery and conflict behavior, destination reference and absence behavior, legacy migration error behavior, unknown-field policy, and path identity rules; the active configuration-authority Canon page records the durable contract; implementation beads can proceed without guessing.

title: Define managed-item identity, applicability, selectors, and collision semantics
description:
Owner decision required for source declaration identity and destination applicability. Define stable file and section identities, the applicable matching rule for inference, all/allow/exclude combination semantics, absent versus intentionally empty repository policy, duplicate declarations, source precedence direction, and collisions among whole-file and partial-section declarations.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner supplies a complete truth table for inference and configured selection, identity and collision rules, and the source-order winner; the configuration-authority and managed-content Canon pages record the durable contract; planning and catalog tests can be written without invented selectors or overlap behavior.

title: Retire general-purpose repository creation
description:
## Constitutional finding

Growth Directive 5 says to grow through file and section synchronization, "not by expanding into general repository orchestration." Boundary 1 limits Omnirepo to synchronization plus commit, push, checks, and sync-induced repair.

## Current evidence

src/bin/main.rs exposes new; src/new/project_creation.rs creates arbitrary repositories, copies tag-selected templates, and runs git init. README.md presents repository creation as a core product feature.

## Scope

Remove the general new command and its production module, tests, and documentation. Any future onboarding must be a synchronization-specific setup path driven by the constitutional configuration and inference model, not a generic project generator.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.
acceptance_criteria: The public CLI has no general new command; project creation/template-generation code and obsolete tests are removed; README and package wording no longer claim general project generation; installation-to-first-sync onboarding remains covered by the configuration/inference beads; all Canon quality gates pass.

title: Define managed-text encoding and exactness contract
description:
Owner decision required because the current String and HTTP text paths may reject invalid UTF-8 or alter BOM and replacement characters while Canon requires faithful exact text. Select whether the authoritative unit is bytes or a named text encoding, supported encodings, BOM handling, invalid-sequence behavior, and the comparison unit.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines the supported representation and exact comparison semantics, including Unicode, BOM, invalid sequences, and newline preservation; managed-content Canon records the rule; catalog, whole-file, partial-section, and documentation beads adopt it consistently.

title: Define managed-section delimiter grammar and format coverage
description:
Owner decision required before literal public delimiters can be implemented. Select the marker grammar and section identity, initial extension-to-comment-syntax registry, extension matching, unknown or extensionless behavior, whitespace matching, line versus block comments, ambiguity handling, and append separator and newline convention.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner selects the exact start and end grammar, section identity, supported format registry, matching rules, invalid cases, and append convention; managed-content Canon records the durable behavior; the partial-section engine and examples can proceed without guessing.

title: Define verification-command execution contract
description:
Owner decision required for repository-declared checks. Define argv versus shell representation, configured order, working directory, environment inheritance, stdin, timeout and cancellation, descendant termination, stdout and stderr capture limits, and exit, signal, spawn, and timeout classification.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines the complete check process contract and finality guarantees; fleet-lifecycle Canon records the durable behavior; config schema, verifier, evidence, harness, and lifecycle beads can implement and test it without ambient shell or timeout assumptions.

title: Define scoped Git mutation and push contract
description:
Owner decision required before Omnirepo may commit or push. Define treatment of pre-existing staged, unstaged, untracked, and same-file outside-section changes; staging method; existing unpushed commits; branch and upstream selection; detached, unborn, ahead, behind, and diverged states; commit identity, message, hooks and signing; force policy; authentication; timeout, retry, and failure residue.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines a Git contract that cannot publish unrelated work or pre-existing commits accidentally; fleet-lifecycle Canon records it; integration tests cover the full dirty and branch matrix plus commit and push failure states before the Git adapter is implemented.

title: Define run-record schema, evidence, and sensitive-data policy
description:
Owner decision required for the durable timestamped run record. Define schema and versioning, unique naming and collision behavior, creation before mutation, crash and finalization semantics, permissions, redaction scope, output and evidence limits, retention, and the command outcome when the record cannot be created or finalized.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines durable record lifecycle, schema, repository identity, evidence bounds, redaction, permissions, collision, retention, and failure semantics; fleet-lifecycle Canon records the contract; reporting can be implemented without guessing security or persistence guarantees.

title: Define repair eligibility, attempt accounting, and agent confinement
description:
Owner decision required for proving a failure was caused by the current synchronization and for bounding repair. Define run and repository lineage, pre-existing versus introduced failure evidence, uncertainty handling, attempt budget scope and persistence across crashes or tool fallback, what consumes an attempt, frozen verification policy, agent invocation environment, protected roots, and enforcement outside prompts.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines causal eligibility, attempt accounting, restart and fallback behavior, the immutable original plan and checks, supported agent invocation boundaries, and all protected authorities and filesystem scopes; fleet-lifecycle Canon records the contract; repair and agent-adapter beads can proceed safely.

title: Define declared migration artifact and lifecycle contract
description:
Owner decision required for the explicitly delegated migration requested for breaking Omnirepo releases. Define declaration location and schema, release and version applicability, identity, idempotence, delegation signal, destination selection, agent use, verification and Git delivery, partial failures, and exit and record semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner defines a machine-readable declared migration and complete explicitly delegated lifecycle, including protected machine and source authority and prohibition on unrelated maintenance; fleet-lifecycle Canon records it; migration implementation and 0.8.x guidance can proceed without inventing policy.

title: Define fleet CLI and process outcome contract
description:
Owner decision required for the machine-driven product surface after legacy new, clone, run, and ad hoc sync are retired. Define synchronization, repair, and migration commands, permitted overrides, empty fleet behavior, preflight and partial-failure exit codes, summary-write failure behavior, cancellation, and quiet versus failure output.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The owner selects the complete constitutional CLI surface and stable process outcomes; fleet-lifecycle Canon records durable behavior; no command accepts ad hoc content authority or arbitrary fleet execution; final CLI wiring and snapshots can proceed.

title: Implement repository-declared verification executor
description:
Implement the internal verifier used only by synchronization and permitted recovery. Execute each repository-owned check exactly under the decided process contract, collect typed bounded evidence, terminate reliably, and preserve peer independence. This is not a public arbitrary command runner.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Checks execute in configured order and repository scope with decided cwd, environment, timeout, cancellation, and output semantics; spawn, nonzero, signal, timeout, and success are typed; a failed or hung check cannot suppress other repository outcomes or the durable record; hermetic integration tests pass.

title: Implement scoped Git commit and push adapter
description:
Implement Git mutation as a narrow lifecycle adapter after successful synchronization and verification. Stage and commit only the current authorized delta under the decided Git contract, preserve unrelated index and worktree state, and push only the exact permitted commit and ref without force or incidental publication.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Changed clean-pass repositories create an inspectable scoped commit and permitted push; unchanged repositories create no commit; failing checks create no Omnirepo commit or push; unrelated staged, unstaged, untracked, same-file outside-section, and pre-existing commit state is handled exactly as decided; all Git states and failures yield typed outcomes.

title: Implement canonical machine and repository configuration authority
description:
Implement the owner-decided canonical machine, repository, and source-declaration configuration contract. Machine configuration alone owns fleet membership, ordered authoritative sources, and source priority. Root repository policy owns only applicability, repository verification commands, and assigned execution controls. Remove or reject arbitrary config-location and legacy working-directory authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Only the decided canonical machine and repository locations and formats load; machine config contains exactly fleet and ordered-source authority plus assigned controls; repository policy cannot redefine fleet, authoritative sources, or source priority; unknown, duplicate, conflicting, malformed, and cross-role identities fail contextually before mutation; legacy .omni.yaml produces an explicit migration error and never triggers inference; alternate CLI config authority is removed or rejected as decided; round-trip and invalid-case tests pass.

title: Implement configured agent CLI adapter with enforced confinement
description:
Implement deterministic configured discovery and invocation shared by repair and explicitly delegated migration. Enforce protected roots, authority, process limits, and evidence capture outside the prompt; do not grant agents commit, push, source, fleet, or run-record authority.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Configured tool selection is deterministic; invocation follows the decided cwd, environment, timeout, termination, and evidence protocol; forbidden writes and authority changes are prevented or detected and rejected; prompt injection, crash, timeout, oversized output, and cross-repository attempts are covered by fake-agent tests.

title: Wire the machine-driven fleet synchronization CLI
description:
Replace the ad hoc sync surface with the constitutional fleet command. Load only canonical machine and repository authority, snapshot source declarations, plan every declared destination, execute the independent lifecycle, always attempt the durable record, and return the decided process status.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The public sync invocation accepts no arbitrary URL, local file, template ID, target fleet, or source precedence override; every declared destination receives one outcome; preflight, empty, partial, success, cancellation, and record-failure cases match the CLI contract; end-to-end tests exercise the machine-driven flow.

title: Add final constitutional acceptance suite
description:
Add an epic-level black-box suite proving the completed product obeys the Constitution across CLI, configuration authority, exact whole and partial synchronization, containment, independent outcomes, verification, Git, records, repair, and migration. This supplements rather than duplicates component tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: The suite exercises lawful success and each constitutional limit end to end, including rejection of legacy general orchestration, destination-to-source promotion, inference over explicit policy, semantic editing, outside-fleet mutation, failed-check publication, unbounded repair, and implicit migration; it passes on the MSRV and contributes to coverage gates.

title: Make release provenance deterministic and gate publication
description:
The main-push bump and release workflows run independently. Release builds the triggering commit but selects the globally highest tag, so a race can attach binaries from one commit to a tag for another; the release is also published before all artifacts are uploaded. Define and implement a deterministic tag-to-source release flow gated by required validation.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: A release is triggered from or verifies one exact tag and commit; Linux and macOS binaries are proven to come from that commit; all required quality and coverage gates complete before public publication; artifact failure cannot leave a misleading successful release; workflow tests or static validation cover the provenance path.

title: Unify local and CI coverage gate execution
description:
Coverage thresholds are enforced in CI, but local documented piping and duplicated report commands can mask the cargo llvm-cov exit status or present stale evidence. Provide one authoritative local and CI entry point that preserves the threshold result and report artifacts.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: One repository-owned coverage command enforces 95 percent lines, 80 percent functions, and 80 percent regions with locked all-target all-feature settings; local and CI call the same gate; report generation cannot replace or mask the threshold exit status; documentation and tests or workflow validation are updated.

title: Load source-repository declarations with deterministic precedence
description:
Load source-side declarations under the decided schema and exact-text representation. Snapshot the complete ordered source catalog before any destination mutation. Resolve overlap solely by the decided source-order rule and managed-item identity; never inspect destination content for authority or accept CLI ad hoc sources. Source reads remain confined to each declared source root, source repositories remain immutable, and source and destination roles cannot overlap.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture sources declare whole files and sections under the decided schema; one catalog snapshot preserves configured order and exact content; reversing source order reverses the selected overlap winner while concurrency and content do not; duplicate and collision cases follow the owner contract; canonical aliases and symlinks cannot make a destination a source or escape a source root; CLI and destination content cannot become authority; errors occur before destination mutation.

title: Build per-repository synchronization plans with explicit scope and inference
description:
For every machine-declared destination, combine the immutable ordered source catalog with that repository policy into an explicit plan using the owner-decided identity, applicability, selector, and collision rules. Only absent policy permits inference; present, even intentionally empty, policy wholly governs scope. Record inclusion and exclusion reasons without changing precedence.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Every and only machine-declared destination receives a plan; absent policy infers exactly the applicable declarations; present policy follows the complete all/allow/exclude truth table and never falls back to inference; malformed policy fails without inference; exclusion is monotonic; ordering and collisions follow the decided rules; table and property tests cover absent, empty, mixed, invalid, overlap, and zero-item plans.

title: Implement idempotent exact whole-file synchronization
description:
Implement the whole-file operation over a resolved plan entry using the owner-decided exact representation. Current unconditional String fs::write actively rewrites equal targets and can alter representation acquired through HTTP text decoding. Compare without semantic parsing, report unchanged versus changed, create permitted parent paths, and replace drifted content exactly with structured item results.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Missing and drifted whole files become exactly authoritative under the decided encoding or byte contract; equal targets are reported unchanged and demonstrably not rewritten, including a read-only or metadata witness; repeat sync is a filesystem no-op; LF, CRLF, mixed and absent final newlines, Unicode, BOM, empty content, and decided invalid-sequence cases are tested; acquisition failure preserves all destinations; failures are contextual and peers continue.

title: Implement managed partial sections and delimiter knowledge
description:
Implement partial managed sections using the owner-decided delimiter grammar and comment-syntax registry. Match exact marker lines or tokens, replace only one valid bounded body, append one canonical section only under the decided absence convention, and never parse surrounding configuration semantically. All ambiguity must fail before mutation.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Supported formats render the exact decided delimiters; one valid pair replaces only its body and preserves prefix and suffix exactly including newline style and missing final newline; empty bodies, adjacent markers, marker-like payload text, and repeat no-op work; reversed, interleaved, nested, duplicate, unmatched, unknown, and ambiguous cases fail contextually with file and section identity and preserve the file; missing file or pair follows the decided append and separator rule; property tests prove only the bounded span changes.

title: Enforce symlink-safe containment within the declared fleet
description:
Build reusable containment primitives for each declared authority root. Current lexical joins are followed by symlink-following reads and writes and can escape the fleet. Resolve the owner-decided path identity, reject alias and traversal escapes, and perform source reads and destination mutations without re-resolving through attacker-controlled links. Later verifier, Git, and agent beads must integrate the same guard.

## Steps to Reproduce

Use the current public surface or workflow described above and observe the stated boundary or gate failure.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Machine, source, destination, config, intermediate, and leaf paths obey the decided identity and containment rules; absolute, parent, canonical alias, symlink, hard-link escape, special-file, and concurrent replacement cases cannot cause an outside-authority mutation; legitimate roots and nested absent leaves work; one rejected repository does not stop peers; primitives have integration hooks and regression tests for later process and Git adapters.

title: Build a hermetic fleet lifecycle integration-test harness
description:
Create schema-neutral hermetic fixtures for multi-repository lifecycle tests: isolated HOME and PATH, source and destination roots, bare remotes, deterministic clocks and run IDs, fake processes and agents, and explicit synchronization barriers. Concrete config writers should be added only after their schema decisions land; ambient network, Git config, credentials, proxies, and toolchains must not influence results.

## Acceptance Criteria

See the structured acceptance criteria field.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures create isolated repositories and remotes and assert exact commits and refs; fake commands and agents capture bounded binary-safe input and output and support spawn, signal, hang, descendant, timeout, crash, and oversized-output cases; deterministic barriers prove concurrency rather than sleeping; clocks and run IDs exercise collisions; hostile HOME, PATH, Git, proxy, symlink, hard-link, and special-file fixtures are available; MSRV and CI pass.
